name: AI News Digest
description: Pulls 5 RSS feeds, picks the most interesting stories, writes an opinionated daily digest.

name: AI Thoughts
description: Proposes sourced editorial drafts from RSS reporting. Drafts stay out of public routes and feeds until their claims are reviewed.

name: The Radar
description: Scans RSS feeds and HackerNews Algolia API for genuine AI product launches, writes editorial picks.

name: Tool of the Week
description: Picks one interesting AI tool from RSS feeds and writes a short review.

name: Prompt proposals
description: Proposes two unpublished prompt drafts for editorial review. There is no automatic promotion to a published recipe.

name: Model price snapshots
description: Checks the tracked model IDs against OpenRouter's public price catalogue in GitHub Actions. Changed data passes validation and a site build before publication. No paid model call.
schedule: Daily at 05:30 UTC in GitHub Actions

name: Horizon
description: Proposes Now-lane entries and Past-promotion candidates from the archive, flags stale Next forecasts with fresh supporting evidence. Writes proposals to a staging file for Valori review; never writes canonical lane data.
